dct_description_sm: The long-term objective is to provide information in the form of results and discussion in refereed and popular scientific publications that will convince other countries of the need to reduce sources of these substances. This should serve to support international negotiations. The ultimate aim is to reduce contaminant exposure experienced by wildlife and human residents of the Canadian Arctic ecosystem.
dct_subject_sm: Health sciences and contaminants -> Persistent organic pollutants (POPs)
dct_title_s: Contributing to International Action on POPs and Mercury: Further applications of global mass balance models
